tip.title: 用 firecrawl 替代 requests 抓取网页
tip.body:
当Agent需要从网页抓取实时数据（如新闻、价格）时，直接用`requests`可能被反爬或解析失败。

用`firecrawl`的API一键抓取并结构化：
```python
from firecrawl import FirecrawlApp

app = FirecrawlApp(api_key="你的API密钥")
# 抓取并返回Markdown格式
result = app.scrape_url("https://example.com", params={"formats": ["markdown"]})
print(result["markdown"])
```
注意：API密钥存环境变量，勿硬编码。若需执行抓取结果中的代码，用`subprocess.run`配合白名单路径。

（基于条目[1] firecrawl/firecrawl）

items.title: One in five enterprises can't stop a runaway AI agent's spending in real time
items.raw_text: Enterprise AI teams have stopped betting on a single orchestration platform. The median enterprise now runs three at once — not by accident, but because none of them fully trusts a single vendor to run the show, according to VB Pulse data . This is not just to avoid vendor lock-in and retain flexibility (although that’s a big part of it). There’s still a lot of uncertainty, even distrust, in vendors’ security and permissioning capabilities. Enterprises want the ability to impose their own. Microsoft leads on primary usage today, while Anthropic leads by a wide margin in what enterprises are considering next.
